requirement: The system shall support user registration and user or administrator login using account, password, and verification code, validate the selected identity and permissions, and persist user profiles, role information, and login-state data.
The system shall allow authenticated administrators to manage user accounts in batches and reject unauthorized access to management functions.

The system shall allow logged-in users to submit food photos, preprocess and validate images locally, run backend model inference, and combine the results with recipe data to return recipes including ingredients and cooking steps; non-food images shall be rejected with explanatory feedback.
The system shall allow logged-in users to search recipes by keywords, return matching recipes ranked by relevance, and indicate when no matching recipe is found.
The system shall analyze recognized recipes using recipe and nutrition data to provide nutritional information and calorie assessment, and shall retain ingredient calorie data used in the analysis.
The system shall store ingredient-pair food-combination restriction rules and use them to provide food-combination warnings for recipes.

The system shall retain users' health profiles and health-analysis records, combine recipe, nutrition, and personal health data to generate personalized nutrition advice, and create diet plans with calorie targets for each meal based on user needs and physical conditions.
The system shall record daily diet-plan check-ins and provide an overall diet evaluation, calorie analysis, and subsequent advice based on the check-in records after the plan cycle.

The system shall allow logged-in users to submit recipe text and images for administrator approval or rejection, persist the content and review status, publish and distribute approved content to the community, and return the review outcome to the submitter.
The system shall allow users to browse shared recipe content, like and comment on it, and persist the resulting interaction records.

The system shall retain recommendation features and user query, search, recipe-analysis, and sharing history, and use these records together with user follows to generate and retain recipe or user recommendations.
The system shall allow authenticated administrators to add recipes to the recipe database, upload datasets, and handle user feedback.
The system shall retain merchant information and geographic coordinates and display merchant locations on a map when users access community sharing or merchant-related content.
The system shall provide a mobile client interface that communicates with backend services and is usable on common Android and iOS terminals.
The mobile interface shall provide clear, simple, and smooth workflows for uploading photos and obtaining recipe information.
The system shall be immediately restartable after non-hardware faults and preserve persistent data across the restart.
The system shall protect user personal information and uploaded photos from disclosure to third parties.
The system shall reject improper operations and invalid data writes, and perform image and recipe uploads atomically so incomplete recipe entries are not created.
The backend shall cache data to improve processing performance.
The backend shall be deployable on mainstream operating systems.
The system shall allow its data representations, backend interfaces, and frontend layout to be modified and extended for future business growth.
